title: Table 3 from rem:trivial-knot-photon-interpretation
html:
Term Product NF Interpretation
(9) \varphi_1\sigma_1 \cdot \mathbf{1} \varphi_1\sigma_1 Vertical passes through core; unchanged.
(10) \varphi_1\sigma_1 \cdot \psi_0\sigma_0 \varphi_1\psi_0 L_- Cross-polarization linking (reversed). Vertical meets horizontal and they link into L_- = \sigma_1\sigma_0. Compare term (7): the ordering of which photon contributes which polarization determines the chirality of the link (L_+ vs L_-).
(11) \varphi_1\sigma_1 \cdot \psi_1\sigma_1 \varphi_1\psi_1\,\mathbf{1} + \varphi_1\psi_1 h\,\sigma_1 Same-axis collision (vertical). Identical structure to term (6): partial annihilation to vacuum plus residual polarization.
(12) \varphi_1\sigma_1 \cdot \psi_{01}V \varphi_1\psi_{01}\bigl(e^- - h\,L_-\bigr) Vertical polarization meets the vertex: electron production. Via \sigma_1\sigma_0\sigma_1^{-1} = \sigma_1\sigma_0\sigma_1 - h\,\sigma_1\sigma_0 = e^- - hL_-. The vertical crossing of one photon completes the vertex of the other into the electron word e^-, with an h-weighted L_- remainder.
